text:
anita: quick follow-up from the PM: during last night's cross-region cert flip we saw a concentrated retry storm in ap-south for ~9m; some TLS handshakes returned SNI mismatch.
mike: can we capture owners and short eta here? need to update the runbook and tenant comms.
sre_lee: i'll own the remediation: add a two-phase rotator (prepare + commit) and a propagation sanity check before commit. ETA: 8d. JIRA NET-2051.
tara: i'll own short-term LB mitigation: lower retry attempts to 2 and increase backoff multiplier during scheduled rotators under a feature flag. PR by Tue. JIRA NET-2052.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: cert-rotator canary scheduled v4.2.0 -> v4.2.1 on 2025-03-04T01:00Z (dry-run 30m prior).
sre_lee: added alert draft (PromQL): sum by(region)(rate(lb_retry_total[5m])) / sum by(region)(rate(lb_request_total[5m])) > 0.035 for 8m -> page SRE.
mike: i'll draft tenant comms + runbook snippet; will include opt-out steps. ETA: 48h. OPS-1100.
anita: action table for copying:
- sre_lee, NET-2051, two-phase rotator + sanity check, 8d
- tara, NET-2052, LB backoff feature flag, Tue EOD
- mike, OPS-1100, comms + runbook, 48h

sre_lee: scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to review acceptance criteria. keep updates in this thread and paste PR links when ready.
